o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اتمك (etmek), from Proto-Turkic *etmek (“bread”). Cognate with Turkish ekmek, Bashkir икмәк (ekmäk), see it for more cognates.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اكمك (ekmek), from Proto-Turkic *ek- (“to sow”). Cognate with Chuvash ак (ak, “to saw”).
